probation_length.description:
We recommend on choosing the longest probationary period legally possible.
If a termination is needed, this makes the process easier.
The maximum probationary period is as follows:
- Fixed term contract with duration of 6 months or less: it's 1 month fixed.
- Fixed term contract with duration of 1 year or less: maximum of 2 months;
- Fixed term contract with duration of more than 1 year: maximum of 3 months.
The notice period during the probationary period is 3 days.

We recommend on choosing the longest probationary period legally possible.
If a termination is needed, this makes the process easier.
The maximum probationary period for an indefinite term contract is 3 months.
The notice period during the probationary period is 3 days.

time_tracking_rules_ack.description:
Latvian law requires employees to record work schedules and overtime.

It is the employer's obligation to track the working hours (required to maintain records of each employee's working time) of all employees, and failure to do so may result in a fine of up to EUR 1100.

The following categories of working hours must be tracked:
- Total hours worked
- Overtime hours
- Hours worked during night shifts
- Hours worked during the weekly rest period
- Hours worked on public holidays
- Standstill time

Learn more. (Open drawer)
